connector.name: Fodda Earnings Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Cross-company earnings trends & executive divergence with citable sources.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.fodda.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.fodda, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your Fodda API key (e.g. 'Bearer sk_live_...')
